description: Only after Dream On's own options don't work — the group is larger than 8, or none of Dream On's open dates suit the guest — return a link to Islands & Sails, Dream On's sister concierge (run by Dream On's owner), pre-filled with the guest's dates and party size, where they can explore other hand-picked BVI crewed yachts.
